answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 9 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in ripple, checked in tide, and gale shows each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 3171 identities would post 1321 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
